items.title: Domino's Pizza (DPZ) Launches Sweet Heat Smokehouse, Is The Stock Already Fully Valued?
items.summary: Domino's Pizza (DPZ) just rolled out its Sweet Heat Smokehouse Specialty Pizza nationwide, giving investors fresh product news to weigh as the chain looks to capture holiday-season demand. The new Sweet Heat Smokehouse launch lands at a time when momentum in Domino's Pizza shares has picked up in the short term, with a 30 day share price return of 12.24% and a 90 day gain of 3.02%. items.title: How Retirees Can Turn $50,000 Into Passive Income With These 4 Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Selling shares in a down market can lock in losses just when retirees need cash most. Four dividend payers from telecom, asset management, biopharma and pizza offer another route, though one of them already cut its payout once.

items.title: Domino’s Pizza shares rise after Baird upgrades stock on improving sales outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Domino’s Pizza Inc (NASDAQ:DPZ) rose 2.5% in morning trade Friday after Baird upgraded the stock to Outperform from Neutral, with analyst Analyst Chris O’Cull citing what he called a "clearer path to better SSS performance and franchisee profitability". O’Cull lifted his price target to $400 from $320 following recent meetings with management, pointing to a more balanced promotional strategy that supports average ticket performance without disrupting transaction volume
